description: This file defines a handler class 'DeleteCollateralProductHandler' which processes delete commands for collateral products within the collateral management module of the system. It implements processing logic by invoking a service to handle the deletion, and is annotated for transaction management and command handling.

classes.name: DeleteCollateralProductHandler
classes.description: A service class that handles delete commands for collateral products, delegating the delete operation to the associated write platform service. It is annotated to be recognized as a service and as a command handler for 'COLLATERAL_PRODUCT' delete actions.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the delete command by calling 'deleteCollateral' on the injected service, passing the entity ID from the command.
